How many solar panels and batteries do I need to run an AC? The number of solar panels and batteries needed to power your AC unit depends on the AC unit’s power consumption, and typical duration of usage. To run a 12000BTU mini-split AC unit (which is commonly used in tiny homes) for several hours per day, we recommend between 1000 and 2000 watts of solar, and between 4 and 8 kilowatt-hours. 2. How many solar panels or how much solar power do I need for an off-grid tiny home or small cabin? The number of solar panels needed for an off-grid tiny home depends on your daily energy consumption and the capacity of solar panels. 3. Can I install a solar system for my off-grid tiny home or small cabin by myself? Installing a solar system yourself is possible, but it does require some knowledge of electrical systems. If you feel confident and well-informed, go for it! Installing a Renogy AGM tiny home system requires mounting solar panels, connecting panels to circuit breakers and solar inverter chargers, and then connecting the solar inverter charger to the battery bank. Installing a Renogy Lycan tiny home kit simply requires mounting solar panels and connecting them to the Lycan unit. If you have any doubts or want expert guidance, we recommend consulting with a professional or reaching out to our dedicated customer support team. We are here to ensure your solar journey is smooth, successful, and tailored to your specific needs. 4. Should I mount the solar panels on the roof or on the ground? Roof mounting is more discreet and utilizes existing space. Ground mounting will take up additional space but offers easier access for cleaning/maintenance. 5. What is the difference between a 12V and a 48V system? The voltage refers to the battery bank's capacity. A 12V system has lower voltage but higher current, which is suitable for small setups. A 48V system has higher voltage and lower current, and experiences lower energy losses in the form of heat (due to reduced current flow), resulting in an overall more efficient system. 6. Can this solution be integrated with a grid tied system? The answer is yes. This system can be integrated with a grid-tied home and used as a backup/emergency power application. The system is not intended to be tied directly to the grid in such a way that electricity generated by solar may be directly fed back into the grid (such as a fully grid-tied or hybrid solar system is). 7. The number of solar panels and batteries needed to power your AC unit depends on the AC unit’s power consumption, and typical duration of usage. The number of solar panels needed for an off-grid tiny home depends on your daily energy consumption and the capacity of solar panels. 3. Can I install a solar system for my off-grid tiny home or small cabin by myself? Installing a solar system yourself is possible, but it does require some knowledge of electrical systems. If you feel confident and well-informed, go for it! Installing a Renogy AGM tiny home system requires mounting solar panels, connecting panels to circuit breakers and solar inverter chargers, and then connecting the solar inverter charger to the battery bank. Installing a Renogy Lycan tiny home kit simply requires mounting solar panels and connecting them to the Lycan unit. If you have any doubts or want expert guidance, we recommend consulting with a professional or reaching out to our dedicated customer support team. We are here to ensure your solar journey is smooth, successful, and tailored to your specific needs. 4. Should I mount the solar panels on the roof or on the ground? Roof mounting is more discreet and utilizes existing space. Ground mounting will take up additional space but offers easier access for cleaning/maintenance. 5. What is the difference between a 12V and a 48V system? The voltage refers to the battery bank's capacity. A 12V system has lower voltage but higher current, which is suitable for small setups. products.name: VSUN 370W BOB 120 Half Cell Solar Panel
products.description: Full Product Summary VSUN 370W BOB 120 Half Cell Bifacial Solar Panel Manufacturer: VSUN Solar | Series: Black On Black (BOB) | Cell Count: 120 Half Cells | Type: Bifacial Overview The VSUN 370W BOB 120 Half Cell Bifacial Solar Panel is a high-efficiency monocrystalline photovoltaic module designed for residential and light commercial solar installations. Part of VSUN’s Black On Black (BOB) aesthetic series, this panel combines strong electrical performance with a sleek all-black appearance. As a bifacial module, it captures sunlight from both the front and rear of the panel, generating additional energy from reflected light off the roof surface, ground, or surrounding environment — something standard single-face panels cannot do. The panel uses 120 half-cut monocrystalline PERC cells, split from 60 full cells. Half-cut cell technology reduces resistive losses and improves shade tolerance compared to standard full-cell panels, resulting in better real-world energy yield, especially on roofs that experience partial shading throughout the day. Electrical Specifications (STC) Measured at Standard Test Conditions: 1000 W/m², 25°C cell temperature, AM 1.5 spectrum. Front side only. Bifacial gain varies by installation. Specification Value Peak Power (Pmax) 370 Wp (front) Bifacial Gain Up to 10–25% additional output from rear Power Tolerance 0 / +5 W Panel Efficiency ~19.2% Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) ~41.4 V Maximum Power Voltage (Vmp) ~34.5 V Short Circuit Current (Isc) ~11.26 A Maximum Power Current (Imp) ~10.72 A Maximum System Voltage 1000 V DC Max Series Fuse Rating 20 A Temperature Coefficient (Pmax) -0.36% / °C Temperature Coefficient (Voc) -0.30% / °C Temperature Coefficient (Isc) +0.05% / °C NOCT ~45 ± 2°C Physical & Mechanical Specifications Specification Value Cell Type Monocrystalline PERC Half-Cut Bifacial Cell Configuration 120 cells (6 × 20 layout) Dimensions ~1755 × 1038 × 35 mm Weight ~19.5 kg (43 lbs) Frame Black anodized aluminum Backsheet Transparent (allows rear light capture) Front Glass 3.2 mm tempered, anti-reflective coating Rear Glass Transparent bifacial rear surface Junction Box IP68 rated, 3 bypass diodes Cable Length ~1000 mm Connector Type MC4 compatible Key Features & Technology Bifacial Design Unlike standard panels that only collect light from the front, bifacial panels generate power from both sides. Light reflected off the roof surface, ground, gravel, or nearby structures hits the rear of the panel and is converted into additional electricity. Depending on the installation and surface reflectivity, bifacial gain can add 10–25% more energy output over a standard single-face panel — at no extra fuel cost. Half-Cut Cell Technology Standard solar cells are laser-cut in half, creating 120 smaller cells from what would normally be 60 full cells. This reduces the electrical current flowing through each cell by half, cutting resistive losses and improving real-world performance — especially in partial shade conditions. PERC Technology PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) adds a reflective layer to the back of each cell, bouncing unused light back through the cell for a second absorption pass. This boosts efficiency and improves performance in high-heat and low-light conditions compared to standard mono cells. Black On Black (BOB) Aesthetic Black anodized aluminum frame and black busbars across the cell surface create a clean, uniform appearance. The transparent rear of the bifacial design maintains the sleek look while still allowing rear-side light collection. Designed for homeowners and HOA communities where roof appearance matters. Shade Tolerance & Split-String Design The 120-cell layout is split into two independent 60-cell halves, each with its own bypass diodes. If one half of the panel is shaded, only that section is affected — the other half keeps producing power normally. Installation Overview The VSUN 370W BOB Bifacial is compatible with standard solar racking systems. To maximize bifacial gain, elevated mounting with a light-colored or reflective surface beneath the array is recommended. Install the racking system to the roof or ground structure per the racking manufacturer’s instructions. Elevated ground mounts or raised roof mounts improve rear-side light exposure. Position panels on the rails in portrait or landscape orientation based on your array design. Secure panels with mid-clamps and end-clamps — always clamp to the aluminum frame, not the glass. Wire panels in series strings using the MC4 connectors. Connect positive to negative down the string. Route DC wiring to the combiner box, string inverter, or microinverters depending on system design. Verify open-circuit voltage of each string before connecting to the inverter. The IP68 junction box is fully weatherproof — no additional sealing required. Ground panel frames to the racking system per NEC 690 or applicable local electrical code. For maximum bifacial gain, avoid shading the rear of the panel and use a light-colored surface beneath the array where possible. Warranty Coverage Detail Product Warranty 12 years Performance Warranty 25 years linear Year 1 Max Degradation 2% Annual Degradation (Years 2–25) 0.55% per year max Output at Year 25 Minimum 80.7% of rated power Certifications IEC 61215 | IEC 61730 | UL 1703 / UL 61730 | MCS Certified | Salt mist & ammonia resistance certified | Class C fire rating Short WordPress Summary VSUN 370W Black On Black Bifacial Solar Panel 370 watts of clean energy from the front — plus bonus power from the back. The VSUN 370W BOB is a bifacial panel, meaning it captures reflected light off the roof or ground for up to 25% more output than a standard panel. Built with 120 half-cut monocrystalline PERC cells, an all-black design, and backed by a 12-year product warranty and 25-year performance warranty.

products.name: CHIKO Monster Mount; KIT; Foundation, Mount Platform, Qty 4 Pipes
products.description: CHIKO Monster Mount Kit – Foundation Mount Platform (Qty. 4 Pipes) The CHIKO Monster Mount Kit is a heavy-duty foundation and mounting platform designed to support solar carport or ground-mount structures. The kit typically includes a reinforced base assembly with four structural pipes that anchor the system securely into the ground or foundation. It is engineered for strength, stability, and long-term durability, helping distribute structural loads while maintaining proper alignment of the mounted system. The design supports quick installation and reliable performance in residential or light commercial solar mounting applications.

products.name: Enphase Connector Female for Q Cable
products.description: Enphase Female Connector for Q‑Cable (also available under similar listings like Enphase Connector Female, Enphase Field‑wireable Connector Female for IQ Series, etc.) is a field-wireable female AC connector designed to work with Enphase Q Cable in solar installations. It lets you finish or extend runs of Q Cable by adding a connector on site rather than using pre-terminated ends. Main Purpose Used to attach to an open end of Q Cable (the “raw” Q cable you might cut to length) so it can plug into the rest of the Enphase system. Allows connections from a Q Cable open connector or center-feed section within branch limits — useful when routing cables around an array, creating extensions, or making jumpers. How It Works It’s a female field-wireable connector (meaning you crimp or install the connector onto the cable in the field rather than having it pre-installed). These connectors typically include the body and MC-style crimpable female pins that are attached to the cable conductors, then snapped together with a matching male connector as needed. Why It’s Useful Installation flexibility: Instead of using a fixed pre-terminated cable, you can cut Q Cable to the precise length and install connectors where needed, reducing waste. Modular system building: You can create custom jumper lengths or bridge between parts of the array by using matching male and female plugs. Connectors are UL-listed and designed for outdoor solar AC environments (ratings and exact specs depend on the specific connector model).

products.name: Enphase Q Cable w/Connector for 60/72 Cell Portrait
products.description: This is a pre-wired, outdoor-rated AC trunk cable used with Enphase IQ Series microinverters on solar PV arrays. It’s specifically designed for portrait-oriented solar panels with 60 or 72 cells. Key Features Pre-installed connectors along the cable let microinverters plug directly in — no separate wiring for each inverter is needed. Connector spacing is typically about 1.3 m (about 4.2 ft) to match portrait panel rows. The cable is a continuous length of 12 AWG with double insulation and is significantly lighter than older Enphase cable generations, making installation simpler. It’s rated for up to ~600 V with connectors rated ~250 VAC, and uses THHN/THWN-2 insulation for both wet and dry conditions. Plug-and-play design and cable numbering improve wire management and speed up install. Typical Use Used on the AC side of solar panels in a portrait layout to connect multiple microinverters in series to the branch circuit. Cable can be cut or extended as needed, and unused connectors are sealed with caps (sold separately). Notes It’s considered a professional installation component — usually installed by a solar electrician or installer. Different lengths/connectors exist for landscape orientation or different microinverter models; make sure to match the cable type to your system.

products.name: ENPHASE Q-DISC-10 DISCONNECT TOOL
products.description: The Enphase Q‑DISC‑10 Cable Disconnect Tool (often sold in singles or packs like Cable Disconnect Tool, Pack of 10) is a specialized disconnect tool designed for Enphase solar microinverter cable systems. It’s used during installation, maintenance, or service to safely and easily disconnect cable connectors in an Enphase array. Main Purpose Disconnect Q Cable connectors: Helps release the snap-in connectors used on Enphase Q Cable AC wiring without damaging them. Works on multiple connectors: Can also be used to disconnect EN/MC4 style DC connectors and various AC module connections on Enphase systems. Designed so installers can disengage the connectors without prying or twisting, improving safety and preventing damage. Typical Use Routine servicing — disconnecting microinverters or Q cable drops when replacing components. System adjustments — removing or re-routing cables during layout changes. Safe maintenance — avoids connector damage that could occur from improvised tools.

products.name: Enphase Q Cable w/Connector for 60 Cell Lan
products.description: This is a pre-terminated Enphase Q Cable designed for 60-cell solar modules mounted in landscape orientation. It’s part of the Enphase IQ System cabling accessories and connects multiple IQ Series microinverters along the roof row. Key Features Pre-installed, plug-and-play connectors: Mount microinverters directly without field wiring at each drop. Optimized spacing for landscape layout: Connector spacing ~2.0 m (~6.5 ft) so it fits horizontally oriented 60-cell panels. Lightweight 2-wire cable: About 50 % lighter than older generation Enphase cabling, making handling and installation easier. Simplified wire management: Numbered cable and connectors reduce confusion and waste during installation. Outdoor-rated: UL and UV resistant with THHN/THWN-2 insulation for wet/dry roof conditions. Rated ~600 V with connector rating ~250 VAC. Typical Use Forms the AC branch circuit for Enphase microinverters on landscape-mounted solar panel rows. Connects microinverter outputs efficiently while reducing field wiring and installation time. Often cut to the number of inverter drops needed and installed by a solar electrician.

products.name: Enphase Q Cable w/Connector for 72 Cell Lan
products.description: A pre-terminated AC trunk cable designed for Enphase IQ Series microinverter solar systems using 72-cell solar modules installed in landscape orientation. It comes with connectors already built in at set intervals to plug directly into microinverters, making wiring easier during installation. Key Features Landscape-specific spacing: Connectors spaced farther apart (~2.3 m or ~7.5 ft) to match the wider layout of 72-cell panels mounted horizontally. Pre-installed plug-and-play connectors: Simplifies wiring and speeds up installation compared with hand-wired cabling. Two-wire, lightweight cable: Approximately 50 % lighter than older generation Enphase cable, improving handling on the roof. Outdoor rated: UL listed, suitable for wet/dry environments, heat resistant, and UV resistant. Custom lengths possible: Cable is typically cut to order based on how many inverter drops you need. Typical Use This cable forms the AC branch circuit linking multiple Enphase microinverters for panels in a landscape layout. Each connector corresponds to a microinverter, and unused ends can be sealed or extended as needed. It’s installed by a professional electrician as part of a grid-tied solar array.

products.name: K2 Corregated Power Clamp Kit

products.name: K2 Cross Rail End Clamp Silver, 40-47mm 4000092
products.description: K2 Cross Rail End Clamp Silver, 40–47 mm K2 Systems CrossRail End Clamp 4000092The K2 Cross Rail End Clamp Silver (4000092) is a module-mounting component used at the outer edges of a solar array to secure panels to K2 CrossRail racking systems. Key Features Designed to cover hook penetrations and improve waterproofing on tile roofs. Compatible with all K2 tile hooks and roof types. Made from corrosion-resistant 6000-series aluminum. Simple installation with a bead of sealant.

products.name: K2 Trapezoidal Power Clamp Kit

products.name: Enphase IQ Battery 10C AC Coupled 10.0kWh Home Battery

It uses integrated microinverter technology and lithium iron phosphate (LFP) chemistry to deliver high power output, strong safety performance, and modular expandability. products.name: Enphase IQ Combiner 6C with IQ Gateway

products.name: Enphase IQ Meter Collar
products.description: Enphase IQ Meter Collar The Enphase IQ Meter Collar is a compact microgrid interconnect device (MID) that enables whole-home backup functionality in Enphase solar + battery systems by providing automatic grid disconnection and integrated metering without requiring a backup sub-panel or extensive rewiring. Utilities like PG&E, SDG&E, and many others have approved the Meter Collar for behind-meter use, helping broaden its applicability. products.name: Enphase IQ8AC Microinverter
products.description: Enphase IQ8AC is a high-efficiency, grid-forming solar microinverter that converts direct current (DC) from individual solar panels into alternating current (AC) for use in homes or small commercial systems. It’s part of Enphase’s IQ8 Series, which emphasizes advanced electronics, reliability, and smart system integration. Key Features & Benefits: Microinverter per Panel: Converts DC to AC at each panel for panel-level optimization, reducing losses from shading or mismatch and improving overall system energy yield. High Efficiency: Delivers ~97% peak conversion efficiency, helping maximize energy harvest from high-performance modules. Grid-Forming / Backup Ready: Designed with advanced ASIC technology, enabling formation of a microgrid during outages when paired with compatible Enphase system components. Seamless Integration: Works with the Enphase IQ Battery, IQ Gateway, and Enlighten/Enphase App for real-time monitoring, remote updates, and system management. Easy Installation: Lightweight, compact design with plug-and-play MC4 or Q-DCC connectors and simple two-wire cabling simplifies wiring and installation. Safety & Compliance: Built-in rapid shutdown and compliance with standards like UL 1741/IEEE 1547 and CA Rule 21 improve safety and grid compatibility. Durability & Warranty: Over one million hours of reliability testing supports long life and an industry-leading limited warranty (up to ~25 years). Typical Use Cases:Ideal for residential and light commercial solar arrays, especially where panel-level monitoring, optimized performance, and future backup capacity are priorities. These microinverters pair well with high-output PV modules (295 W–500 W) to get the best performance across varied conditions.

products.name: Enphase IQ8MC Microinverter Integrated MC4
products.description: Enphase IQ8MC Microinverter with Integrated MC4 – Summary The Enphase IQ8MC is a high-efficiency, grid-forming solar microinverter with integrated MC4 connectors, designed for residential photovoltaic systems. It converts DC power from each solar panel into AC power for the home electrical system, enabling optimized panel-level performance and enhanced system flexibility. Key Features & Benefits Integrated MC4 Connectors: Built-in MC4 inputs simplify rooftop wiring by eliminating the need for additional adapter cables, reducing installation labor and potential failure points. High Conversion Efficiency: Efficient DC-to-AC conversion maximizes energy harvest from PV modules, improving overall system output. Grid-Forming Capability: Enables the microinverter to support a stable AC waveform during grid outages when paired with compatible Enphase backup components (e.g., IQ Batteries and Gateway), supporting future backup/ESS integration. Panel-Level Optimization: Individual panel control helps mitigate shading or mismatch losses and provides more granular performance monitoring. Scalability: System size can grow panel by panel without constraints of a central inverter. Robust & Long-Lasting: Designed for outdoor use with durable construction and backed by a long limited warranty (typically up to 25 years). Safety & Compliance: Complies with modern grid interconnection and rapid shutdown standards for safe operation and code compliance. Typical Use Cases Ideal for residential solar installations where simplified wiring, high energy yield, system scalability, and future backup capability are priorities.

products.name: Enphase IQ8HC Microinverter Integrated MC4
products.description: Enphase IQ8HC Microinverter — High-power, grid-ready, integrated-MC4 solar microinverter designed for modern residential PV systems. Summary:The Enphase IQ8HC is a next-generation solar microinverter tailored for high-output PV modules and delivers efficient DC→AC conversion at the panel level. It combines industry-leading reliability with smart grid compliance and simplified installation for residential solar arrays. Key Features & Benefits: High-Power Output: Supports high-wattage modules (typically 320–540 W) with up to 384 VA peak output and ~380 VA continuous AC power, maximizing energy yield per panel. Grid-Forming & Smart-Grid Ready: Built on advanced ASIC technology, the IQ8HC can support grid-forming operation with compatible Enphase controllers and provides dynamic response to grid conditions. Typical Use Cases:Ideal for residential systems with larger PV panels where high energy production, panel-level optimization, and future backup capability are priorities.

products.name: Enphase IQ8+ Microinverter
products.description: Enphase IQ8+ Microinverter — Summary The Enphase IQ8+ is a modern grid-forming solar microinverter that converts DC power from individual solar panels into AC power for residential grid-tied systems with high reliability and efficiency. It is designed for standard U.S. 240 V split-phase installations and integrates seamlessly with the broader Enphase Energy System, including the IQ Gateway and monitoring tools. Key Features & Advantages Panel-Level Power Conversion: Each microinverter attaches to a solar module, enabling independent DC→AC conversion for better overall energy harvest, improved mismatch and shading tolerance, and more granular performance monitoring. Easy Installation: Lightweight design with plug-and-play MC4 or Q-DCC connectors and simplified two-wire cabling speeds deployment and reduces rooftop complexity. Safety & Compliance: UL 1741/IEEE 1547 rapid shutdown and advanced grid support compliance ensure electrical safety and grid compatibility. Durable & Reliable: Tested over one million hours with an industry-leading limited warranty of up to 25 years, supporting long-term performance. Typical Benefits Maximized energy yield through optimized, module-level operation. Future-ready system design with potential for sunlight backup and battery integration. Simplified installation and maintenance for solar installers.

products.name: EG4 RS232 Firmware Update Cable – LL

products.name: K2 Multi Mount Kit, Mill, DC
products.description: K2 Multi Mount Kit — Solar Roof Attachment Summary The K2 Multi Mount Kit is a versatile solar roof attachment solution engineered to simplify the installation of solar racking systems on a wide range of roof types. Designed with an open slot interface and retention lip, this mounting kit allows for rapid, secure integration with K2 CrossRail rail components — perfect for both flush or tilt-up photovoltaic (PV) panel layouts. Key Features Quick Install Design: Open slot configuration with retention lip enables fast alignment and connection of racking rails, reducing installation time. Pre-Assembled EverSeal: Integrated K2 EverSeal provides a watertight roof attachment without the need for additional sealants. Flexible Attachment Options: Can be affixed to rafters using lag screws or directly to roof decking with structural screws, adapting to different roof constructions. Wide Roof Compatibility: Suitable for diverse roof substrates including asphalt shingle, EPDM, TPO, metal, bitumen, concrete, and more. Universal Rail Fit: Works with all K2 CrossRail profiles and supports both portrait and landscape panel orientations. Durable & Code-Compliant: Constructed from robust aluminum with a design that maintains appropriate clearance and meets structural standards for PV mounting. Why It Matters The K2 Multi Mount Kit provides a reliable, installer-friendly roof connection point for solar racking systems on pitched and low-slope roofs. Its flexible attachment methods and universal compatibility with K2 rail profiles make it ideal for both residential and commercial PV installations where a professional, watertight, and secure mount is required.

products.name: Guardian Gateway
products.description: Fortress Power Guardian Gateway — Product Summary The Fortress Power Guardian Gateway is a smart connectivity device that links your Fortress Power battery system to the internet for real-time monitoring, control, and remote support. Once installed and paired with the companion mobile app (iOS/Android), the Guardian automatically discovers connected 48 V Fortress Power batteries and makes critical system data available in the cloud. Key Features Cloud-Connected Monitoring: View live battery metrics such as State of Charge (SoC), voltage, current, and temperature from anywhere using the mobile app. Remote Firmware Updates: Keep your battery system up to date without an on-site service call. Streamlined Support: Submit warranty registrations, diagnostic data, and support tickets directly through the app, and even access live chat with technical support. Simplified Setup: Wi-Fi enabled with automatic battery discovery for easy integration into existing Fortress Power systems. Enhanced System Visibility: Provides detailed visibility into your energy storage performance for better decision-making and maintenance planning. Why It Matters The Guardian Gateway transforms a Fortress Power battery bank from a local-only device into a connected, remotely accessible energy asset, giving homeowners and installers powerful visibility and management tools. It enhances system reliability, supports maintenance workflows, and improves overall user experience by bringing real-time diagnostics and communication directly to your smartphone or web dashboard.

products.name: Fortress Power eWay lite Battery Box Wire Management System
products.description: Fortress Power eWay Lite Battery Box Wire Management System — Summary The Fortress Power eWay Lite Battery Box Wire Management System is a streamlined wiring enclosure designed to organize and protect the AC, DC, and communication connections for Fortress Power battery systems. Built to simplify installation and improve serviceability, the eWay Lite provides a compact, code-ready pathway for routing cables between multiple Fortress batteries and compatible inverters. This system integrates dedicated wiring channels and conduit entries that help installers create clean, professional, and NEC-compliant battery wiring without needing custom junction boxes or external raceways. By centralizing connection points and reducing clutter, eWay Lite enhances safety, reduces installation time, and improves overall system neatness in residential and light commercial setups. Key Benefits: Organized cable routing for AC, DC, and communications wiring Pre-planned conduit access for clean entry and exit points Supports multiple Fortress batteries with centralized interconnection Compact, enclosure-ready design fits neatly under or alongside battery stacks Promotes professional installations and easier troubleshooting Ideal for installers and integrators deploying Fortress Power battery systems where a simplified, efficient wiring solution is desired without the complexity of larger wireway enclosures.

products.name: Fortress Power eBoost eWay Battery Box Wire Management System
products.description: Fortress Power eBoost eWay Battery Box Wire Management System — Summary The Fortress Power eBoost eWay Wire Management System is a purpose-built AC and DC wireway designed to streamline installations for Fortress Power eBoost battery systems. It provides a clean, enclosed, and code-compliant pathway for power, communication, and conduit connections between the eBoost battery stack and Fortress Envy series inverters. Engineered for professional energy storage deployments, the eWay integrates a high-current internal busbar (up to 750A) to support multi-battery paralleling, enabling scalable system expansion. Its integrated conduit ports, emergency shutoff provisions, and organized cable routing reduce installation time while improving safety, serviceability, and overall system aesthetics. The enclosure mounts directly beneath the eBoost battery stack, eliminating the need for external raceways or junction boxes and delivering a compact, durable, and UL-compliant wiring solution. Designed for residential and light commercial energy storage systems, the eWay ensures a clean, professional finish while maintaining full compatibility with Fortress Power Envy and Envy Duo inverters. Key Benefits: Integrated AC/DC wireway for clean, organized installs 750A internal busbar for multi-battery parallel systems Concealed conduit routing for a professional appearance Code-compliant, UL-ready design for safe installations Direct compatibility with Fortress eBoost batteries and Envy inverters Simplifies installation and improves long-term service access

products.name: Gridboss BSB 50A AC Circuit Breaker for 12KPV
products.description: GridBOSS BSB 50A AC Circuit Breaker for 12KPV — Product Summary The GridBOSS BSB 50A AC Circuit Breaker is a purpose-built AC protection device designed for use with the EG4 12KPV hybrid inverter when integrated into a GridBOSS power distribution or backup panel. Its primary function is to provide reliable overcurrent and short-circuit protection for the inverter’s AC output feed, safeguarding both the inverter and the connected electrical system in residential and light commercial solar + storage installations. Key Features Correctly Sized Protection Rated Current: 50 amps — matched to the nominal AC output capacity of the 12KPV inverter when paired with a GridBOSS distribution configuration. Safety & Compliance Designed to meet applicable electrical safety standards for residential AC protection. Trip-Free Operation Automatically disconnects under overload or short-circuit conditions, even if the breaker handle is held in the on position, ensuring safer, system-protective behavior. System Compatibility Designed for use with EG4 FlexBOSS21K hybrid inverters when integrating AC output into a GridBOSS panel or distribution assembly. products.name: Tigo 7.6kW Energy Storage Hybrid Inverter
products.description: Tigo 7.6 kW Energy Storage Hybrid Inverter – Product Summary The Tigo 7.6 kW Energy Storage Hybrid Inverter is a storage-ready hybrid solar inverter designed for residential PV + battery systems. It is part of Tigo’s Energy Intelligence (EI) platform, providing robust solar energy conversion, smart energy management, and seamless integration with Tigo battery storage and module-level power electronics (MLPE). This inverter combines solar production, battery charging/discharging, and grid interaction in a single, flexible solution suitable for new installations or retrofit projects. Key Features Hybrid Solar + Storage Operation Manages solar PV generation, battery charging/discharging, and grid interaction in real time. Storage-ready: integrates with Tigo EI or GO battery systems to provide backup power, peak shaving, and self-consumption optimization. Power & Output 7.6 kW continuous AC output at 240 VAC for typical U.S. residential applications. Capable of grid-tied export or hybrid (PV + battery + grid) operation depending on system configuration. Solar PV Input & MPPT High DC input tolerance: up to 15.2 kW PV (approximately 200 % DC oversizing relative to AC output). Three independent MPPTs maximize energy harvest across multiple strings or roof orientations. 80 V starting voltage and broad MPPT range support flexible string designs. Energy Intelligence & Optimization Integrates seamlessly with Tigo TS4 MLPE devices for panel-level optimization, monitoring, and rapid shutdown compliance (NEC 690.12). Built-in revenue-grade meter (RGM) for accurate energy measurement and real-time system insights. Communications & Monitoring Wi-Fi and Ethernet connectivity included; optional cellular and RS-485 support available. System setup and monitoring are streamlined through the Tigo EI mobile app, with rapid commissioning in under 10 minutes. Durable, Outdoor-Ready Design Rugged NEMA 4X/IP65-rated enclosure allows outdoor mounting. Lightweight design (~32 lb) simplifies installation and service access. Why It Matters The Tigo 7.6 kW Energy Storage Hybrid Inverter is a versatile core component for solar + storage systems that need: Efficient solar energy conversion balanced with battery support. Module-level optimization and safety features (when paired with TS4 devices). Seamless system monitoring and control through a unified platform. Backup power capability when connected with compatible Tigo batteries and an automatic transfer switch (ATS). This hybrid inverter is ideal for homeowners seeking higher self-consumption, reduced utility dependence, and expanded energy resilience with a scalable, smart solar + storage solution.

products.name: Fortress Power eForce 28.8KWH Modular 200AH 48V Battery
products.description: Fortress Power eForce 28.8KWH Modular 200AH 48V Battery Description: The eForce Stackable Energy Storage System is Fortress Power’s most advanced and scalable solution for whole-home backup, off-grid living, and solar self-consumption. Each 9.6 kWh lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery is designed for long-lasting performance with 8,000 cycles and a 20-year design life, making it ideal for residential and light commercial applications. Engineered for flexibility, eForce modules can be stacked vertically (up to 3 modules) using wireless quick-connect plugs — no cables required — or expanded laterally for systems up to 268.8 kWh. Each stack integrates with the eWay, a smart wireway featuring built-in busbars, conduit ports, an emergency shutoff, and real-time LED status indicators. The Envy Inverter mounts directly to the eWay, forming a streamlined, weather-resistant (IP65) energy tower. This modular architecture enables effortless installation, seamless AC/DC coupling, and full compatibility with Fortress Power’s monitoring app. Whether you’re building a new solar + storage system or upgrading an existing one, the eForce delivers clean, reliable power and unmatched scalability — all backed by an industry-leading warranty for long-term confidence and protection. FEATURES Built with premium lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells rated for 8,000+ cycles and fast-charging capability without compromising performance or longevity. The integrated design eliminates the need for wireways, long cable runs, and additional enclosures, significantly reducing total system cost and installation complexity. Featuring quick-plug technology and a modular stackable form, the eForce system allows for rapid installation with reduced labor and fewer wiring errors. Backed by a standard 15-year industry-leading warranty, with an optional 30-year extension available — offering unmatched long-term value and peace of mind. With an IP65 rating and built-in heating elements, eForce is engineered to perform in extreme temperatures and weather conditions, indoors or out. The streamlined enclosure supports a clean aesthetic and meets NEC and NFPA standards — enabling flexible installation with minimal visual and space impact. Scale your system vertically up to 28.8 kWh per stack or expand laterally up to 268.8 kWh total, adapting to evolving residential or commercial energy needs. Approved for Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs nationwide, enabling customers to earn revenue and support grid reliability with intelligent energy discharge. products.description: Fortress Power Envy True 10KW Hybrid Inverter Description: The Fortress Power Envy True 12kW is a high-performance, all-in-one hybrid inverter designed for whole-home and light commercial applications. With 21 kW of solar PV input and scalable output up to 120 kW AC by paralleling 10 units, it delivers unmatched flexibility for grid-tied, off-grid, or backup systems. It’s fully compatible with all Fortress Power 48V batteries, including the eForce, eVault MAX, and eFlex MAX. Whether you’re looking to achieve energy independence, reduce peak utility rates, or participate in net metering and time-of-use programs, the Envy True 12kW offers advanced control and seamless integration. It even supports zero export and load shifting, helping you optimize energy use and cut electricity costs — with or without solar panels. Approved by utilities across the U.S. and Puerto Rico, the Envy True 12kW also enables participation in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, allowing you to earn compensation for discharging energy back to the grid during periods of high demand. FEATURES With a 21W PV input and 12kW continuous uninterrupted output, the True 12KW offers reliable clean energy and can be expanded by paralleling up to 10 units, with a maximum of 120KW AC output. Designed with built-in AC and DC breakers and generous internal space for wire management, the Envy enables a streamlined installation process — reducing labor time and simplifying wiring for both retrofit and new systems. Avoid the hassle of extra components. The Envy True 12kW features a fully integrated rapid shutdown transmitter, helping your installation meet NEC 2017 & 2020 code requirements without the need for external devices — saving time and cost. The Envy is engineered for residential 120/240V split-phase systems and can also be used in commercial 120/208V or 127/220V three-phase setups with just two or more inverters — offering unmatched versatility for mixed-use projects. Join utility demand response programs and get paid to support the grid. Monitor your solar production, battery performance, and grid consumption anytime via the Fortress Power mobile app. The Envy also supports remote firmware updates, ensuring your system stays up to date without the need for onsite visits.
